page.overview:
Who is Minor Domino High School students?

The following students of Domino High School that are unnamed and have a minor role in the story appear in the Toei Yu-Gi-Oh! anime.

Such male students are usually called schoolboy (男生徒 or 女子生徒) in the ending credits, while female ones are usually called schoolgirl (女生徒 or 女子生徒).

A schoolboy invited Yugi Mutou to play basketball. He is based on a character with the same role in Duel 1 of the manga. He was voiced by Jin Domon

Three schoolgirls commented on Ushio's condition, after his Penalty Game. They were voiced by Saori Kaneda, Rika Komatsu and Sayuri Fujita.
